responsibility: Implements tree-level memory-reference discovery and dependence analysis for loops. It builds DATA_REFERENCE objects from array and memory accesses, computes access functions and innermost-loop behavior, analyzes aliasing and classic dependence relations between references using CHREC-based subscript tests, records distance and direction vectors and runtime-test needs, exposes debug dumping and cleanup helpers, and supplies the dependence engine used by vectorization, loop distribution, predictive commoning, and autoparallelization.
same_name_distinction: Implements the data-reference discovery and dependence-analysis algorithms declared in gcc/tree-data-ref.h, building and testing DATA_REFERENCE/DDR information, dumping results, and freeing analysis objects; the header mainly defines those structures, macros, and query interfaces.
